title: Insider says 10 people have the bigger picture and the intent is a little scary
plain: An insider is said to have claimed that only about 10 people "have the bigger picture" of the UFO secret, and that what those people intend is a little scary. The documentary filmmaker James Fox passes this on, linking it to the journalist Leslie Kean, without saying where it was said. If true, it would mean the full story sits with a very small group whose aims are unsettling.
